body: HunyuanVideo: A Systematic Framework For Large Video Generation Model
plain_description: **Generate videos from text prompts for creative and business projects.** The project includes inference code, pretrained weights, and a web demo. It can also generate images.
technical_description: Open-source video foundation model with PyTorch definitions, pretrained weights, and inference and sampling code. It generates videos from text prompts and supports image and video generation, a Gradio web demo, multi-GPU inference, and FP8 quantized weights. The README reports NVIDIA GPU memory requirements of 45 GB for 544×960×129-frame generation and 60 GB for 720×1280×129-frame generation; 80 GB is recommended.
title: HunyuanVideo: A Systematic Framework For Large Video Generation Model
